title: Effort level and ultrathink in the Claude pane
notes: Claude Code: /effort low to max, the ultrathink keyword, an effort indicator. SDK: effort option (sdk.d.ts:1965), applyFlagSettings({effortLevel}) (3034). Pane: preferences hold only model and mode (chat-sessions.ts:42). Show the level in the foot. Size S.

comments.body: Shipped in PR #105: /effort command, effort level in the foot, ultrathink shown while its turn runs. Version 2.11.0.
